name: productivity-assistant
description: AI-Powered Personal Productivity Assistant — monorepo orchestrator (client + server + ai-service)

scripts.setup: npm run setup:server && npm run setup:client && npm run setup:ai
scripts.setup:server: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate
scripts.setup:ai: cd ai-service && python -m venv .venv && .venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup:ai:unix: cd ai-service && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run prisma:generate
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
